title: HealthBridge: FHIR R4 + OMOP CDM Clinical Data Platform
description: A full-stack clinical data platform combining a SMART-on-FHIR-secured HL7 FHIR R4 API, a Synthea-to-OMOP-CDM-v5.4 ETL pipeline, and population health / A&E demand forecasting dashboards. Built entirely on synthetic patient data.
